people.name: Gilead
people.line: Mountainous region east of Jordan; tribal territory and personal name.

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

translations.web: because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons. The land of Gilead belonged to the rest of the sons of Manasseh.
translations.bsb: because the daughters of Manasseh received an inheritance among his sons. And the land of Gilead belonged to the rest of the sons of Manasseh.
translations.kjv: Because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons: and the rest of Manasseh's sons had the land of Gilead.
translations.asv: because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons. And the land of Gilead belonged unto the rest of the sons of Manasseh.
